summary: Elevra Lithium (ASX:ELV; NASDAQ:ELVR) furnished a Form 6-K with exhibits for its September 7, 2026 ASX announcement of a Pre-Feasibility Study on the staged North American Lithium (NAL) brownfield expansion in Quebec, plus a September 8 corporate presentation. The three-stage plan lifts throughput to 4,500 tpd from mid-CY27, 6,500 tpd from mid-CY28, with permanent crushing by mid-CY29, reaching 373 ktpa spodumene concentrate. Total initial CAPEX is C$366M (US$271M), funded via the May 2026 Strategic Financing Package. This is an operational study, not a special situation.
